THE_ARCHITECT.talk.HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.0-: I have climbed worse than you.
The Architect measures the newcomer's armor.
Faith. How quaint. It will not scale these walls.
Then let us test the shield.
Fascinating. Do you mind if I take a sample?
The Architect regards the newcomer's instruments.
You would dissect me. Others at least had the decency to pray first.
Then let us see your findings.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.HELLOSPIRE-GUNSLINGER: The Architect watches the cylinder turn.
You count your deaths in advance. How practical.
Then let us find out which chamber it was.
NEOW.talk.HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.0-0r.char: You put me back together. You did not ask what I was.
NEOW.talk.HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.0-0r.next: Neow's attention settles on the newcomer's shield straps.
NEOW.talk.HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.0-1r.ancien: ...you were... already broken.... ...I only... kept the shape.....
NEOW.talk.HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMIST.0-0r.char: You reassembled me without a control group.
NEOW.talk.HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMIST.0-0r.next: Neow watches the newcomer uncap something and sniff it.
NEOW.talk.HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMIST.0-1r.anci: ...you would... take me apart.... ...to learn... how I put you... together.....
NEOW.talk.HELLOSPIRE-GUNSLINGER.0-0r.cha: You rebuilt me. Did you leave the count where it was?
NEOW.talk.HELLOSPIRE-GUNSLINGER.0-0r.nex: Neow's gaze drifts across the six chambers, one at a time.
NEOW.talk.HELLOSPIRE-GUNSLINGER.0-1r.anc: ...six... is a small number.... ...to carry... this far.....
OROBAS.talk.HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.0-0r.char: I am not a puppet. I am what is left of an oath.
OROBAS.talk.HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.0-0r.next: Orobas bounces once, and the Paladin's shield rings with it.
OROBAS.talk.HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.0-1r.anci: Oath oath! Heavy heavy! Put it down and play!
OROBAS.talk.HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMIST.0-0r.ch: Hold still. This takes one sample and four minutes.
OROBAS.talk.HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMIST.0-0r.ne: Orobas holds out a fistful of things, none of them labelled.
OROBAS.talk.HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMIST.0-1r.an: Puppet has jars! Jars jars! What's in the jars?!
OROBAS.talk.HELLOSPIRE-GUNSLINGER.0-0r.n: Orobas counts the chambers out loud and gets it wrong twice.
OROBAS.talk.HELLOSPIRE-GUNSLINGER.0-1r.a: Six! Six is my favourite! Do it again, again!
PAEL.talk.HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.0-0r.char: Whoever your Father is, he has let you carry this too long.
PAEL.talk.HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.0-0r.next: Pael does not lift their head. The Paladin does not lower the shield.
PAEL.talk.HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.0-1r.ancien: You hold a line for a light that stopped writing back. I know the feeling.
PAEL.talk.HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.0-attack: Then let us both stop pretending we are rested.
PAEL.talk.HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMIST.0-0r.char: Fatigue that constant is a symptom. May I see your hands?
PAEL.talk.HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMIST.0-0r.next: Pael's fingers are stained with something the Alchemist recognises.
PAEL.talk.HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMIST.0-1r.anci: You want a diagnosis. I want an hour's sleep. Neither of us gets one.
PAEL.talk.HELLOSPIRE-GUNSLINGER.0-0r.cha: I'll check on your Father. After.
PAEL.talk.HELLOSPIRE-GUNSLINGER.0-0r.nex: Pael counts the chambers and loses interest halfway.
PAEL.talk.HELLOSPIRE-GUNSLINGER.0-1r.anc: You count because stopping is worse. I stopped. Don't.
PAEL.talk.HELLOSPIRE-GUNSLINGER.0-attack: Go on. I am too tired to duck.
TEZCATARA.talk.HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.0-0r.c: I will not sit. I have been sitting for a hundred years.
TEZCATARA.talk.HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.0-0r.n: Tezcatara sets out a second cup anyway.
TEZCATARA.talk.HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.0-1r.a: Oh, dear, you brought that shield indoors? Tezcatara insists you put it down.
TEZCATARA.talk.HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMIST.0-0r: Your hospitality is unusual. What are you adding to it?
Tezcatara pours. The Alchemist watches the colour, not the cup.
TEZCATARA.talk.HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMIST.0-1r: Such suspicion, dear! Tezcatara only ever improves the dose.
TEZCATARA.talk.HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMIST.0-at: Then Tezcatara will pour it for you.
TEZCATARA.talk.HELLOSPIRE-GUNSLINGER.0-0: Tezcatara's welcome does not reach the Gunslinger's gun hand.
TEZCATARA.talk.HELLOSPIRE-GUNSLINGER.0-1: Six little rooms, dear, and you sleep in none of them.
DARV.talk.HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.0-0r.char: I am not here for the pile.
DARV.talk.HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.0-0r.next: Darv is already elbow-deep in it, and has forgotten the shield entirely.
DARV.talk.HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.0-1r.ancien: ...no, no — ah! Something for a — sorry, what was it you swore to?
DARV.talk.HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.0-attack: ...oh. That one isn't a gift. Sorry.
DARV.talk.HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMIST.0-0r.char: Your cataloguing is atrocious. May I?
DARV.talk.HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMIST.0-0r.next: The Alchemist starts sorting the pile. Darv watches, delighted.
DARV.talk.HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMIST.0-1r.anci: ...you're labelling them?! Nobody has ever — where did I put the labels...
DARV.talk.HELLOSPIRE-GUNSLINGER.0-0r.cha: Ammunition. That is all I need out of the pile.
DARV.talk.HELLOSPIRE-GUNSLINGER.0-0r.nex: Darv holds up six wrong things in a row.
DARV.talk.HELLOSPIRE-GUNSLINGER.0-1r.anc: ...six? Six of what? I had six of something. Somewhere.
NONUPEIPE.talk.HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.0-0r.c: Keep the blessing. I did not walk here to be forgiven.
NONUPEIPE.talk.HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.0-0r.n: Nonupeipe's hand stays raised over a head that will not bow.
NONUPEIPE.talk.HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.0-1r.a: You came so far to refuse the one thing you came for.
NONUPEIPE.talk.HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.0-atta: Then receive it the hard way.
NONUPEIPE.talk.HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMIST.0-0r: A blessing. Measured in what units?
Nonupeipe offers; the Alchemist produces an empty vial.
NONUPEIPE.talk.HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMIST.0-1r: You would decant grace, label it, and leave it on a shelf.
NONUPEIPE.talk.HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMIST.0-at: Very well. Hold out the jar.
NONUPEIPE.talk.HELLOSPIRE-GUNSLINGER.0-0: I have been blessed before. It cost me a chamber.
Nonupeipe waits with an open palm. The Gunslinger's stays closed.
NONUPEIPE.talk.HELLOSPIRE-GUNSLINGER.0-1: You came so far, and still count what you arrived with.
TANX.talk.HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.0-0r.char: Shout if it helps. The wall does not move.
TANX.talk.HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.0-0r.next: Tanx strikes the Paladin's shield once, just to hear it.
TANX.talk.HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.0-1r.ancien: SO SLOW! BUT NOTHING GETS THROUGH! GOOD! GOOD!
TANX.talk.HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMIST.0-0r.char: Volume is not a variable I can use. Sit.
TANX.talk.HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMIST.0-0r.next: Tanx tears the stopper out of something and drinks it.
TANX.talk.HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMIST.0-1r.anci: SO WEAK! BUT THE BOTTLE IS STRONG! MORE BOTTLES!
TANX.talk.HELLOSPIRE-GUNSLINGER.0-0r.cha: Six. Loud will not change it.
TANX.talk.HELLOSPIRE-GUNSLINGER.0-0r.nex: Tanx presses a weapon into the Gunslinger's hands. It is too big.
TANX.talk.HELLOSPIRE-GUNSLINGER.0-1r.anc: ONLY SIX?! TAKE MINE! TAKE IT!
TANX.talk.HELLOSPIRE-GUNSLINGER.0-attack: USE THEM ALL! ALL OF THEM!
VAKUU.talk.HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.0-0r.char: I already swore to something. It went quiet. I stayed.
VAKUU.talk.HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.0-0r.next: Vakuu's offer hangs in the air. The shield does not lower.
VAKUU.talk.HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.0-1r.ancie: You kneel to a silence. Kneel to me and be answered.
VAKUU.talk.HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMIST.0-0r.cha: Give myself to you. Whole, or in fractions?
VAKUU.talk.HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMIST.0-0r.nex: Vakuu waits. The Alchemist is still writing.
VAKUU.talk.HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMIST.0-1r.anc: You would pour yourself into a jar for anyone but me.
VAKUU.talk.HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMIST.0-attack: I will take the whole of it.
VAKUU.talk.HELLOSPIRE-GUNSLINGER.0-0r.ch: Feared as much as you. That is still one road.
VAKUU.talk.HELLOSPIRE-GUNSLINGER.0-0r.ne: Vakuu extends a hand. The Gunslinger's stays on the grip.
VAKUU.talk.HELLOSPIRE-GUNSLINGER.0-1r.an: Six chambers, and you spend every one on staying yourself.
